components.title: Sea
components.description: The outside water level is the reference for understanding the lower land.

components.title: Low-lying land
components.description: Usable ground inside the enclosing dike. The section exaggerates height differences.

components.title: Coastal dike
components.description: An embankment separates the sea from the interior. Its cross-section here is illustrative.

components.title: Rock facing
components.description: The seaward facing protects the embankment from wave action.

components.title: Planted slope
components.description: Vegetation helps protect the landward soil against erosion.

components.title: Inner barrier wall
components.description: Cement-bentonite limits seawater seepage; it does not make the ground perfectly impermeable.

components.title: Seepage collector
components.description: Collects saline ingress separately from the freshwater drainage system.

components.title: Interior drainage
components.description: Conveys runoff and recirculated water. Only representative branches are drawn.

components.title: Storage pond
components.description: Buffers stormwater before discharge. The shape and level here are schematic.

components.title: Central pumping station
components.description: Recirculates pond water through the drains during dry weather. This is not the sea-discharge station.

components.title: Drainage pumping station
components.description: Moves excess water to sea when the pond reaches its operating level. No real thresholds are shown.

components.title: Inlet / outlet structures
components.description: Connect specific drainage pathways. Cut-off drainage is distinct from the pond route.

components.title: Temporary work enclosure
components.description: Sheet piles keep a local construction area dry; removed after permanent protection is established.

components.title: Ground preparation
components.description: Vertical drainage and temporary loading help consolidate soft soil. Time and settlement are exaggerated.

stops.title: Land below the sea
stops.body: How can dry land sit below the sea? Follow the reference line across the dike to the lower interior. This is a compressed teaching landscape, not a surveyed section.

stops.title: A different way to make land
stops.body: Compare a low polder with a conceptual higher infill platform. The trade-off is less fill and a continuing need to manage water. No quantity or cost calculation is implied.

stops.title: Make the ground ready
stops.body: Drains and temporary surcharge help soft clay consolidate. Scrub to reveal the preparation and settlement. Surveys and investigations check the result; this is not a soil simulation.

stops.title: Build where the water is
stops.body: Create a local dry work cell, place the outlet, then complete its enclosing dike segment. Remove the temporary works once permanent protection is in place. This is a local dependency, not the whole contract schedule.

stops.title: Inside the dike
stops.body: Peel the section open. Facing materials protect the embankment, while the inner barrier limits seepage. Saline ingress has its own collection path.

stops.title: A landscape with plumbing
stops.body: Trace representative interior drains into storage. The cut-off route and saline seepage collector stay separate. Lines end at labelled destinations; smaller branches are omitted.

stops.title: Two different pumping jobs
stops.body: Choose dry weather or a pond-at-operating-level state. One station recirculates water; the other discharges excess water to sea. Buildings represent stations, not an installed pump inventory.

stops.title: Finish, check and maintain
stops.body: Main works finished in December 2024, with further testing and commissioning in 2025. Monitoring and maintenance continue after construction; no live telemetry is connected.

stops.title: Adapt without raising everything
stops.body: Explore a possible higher crest without claiming a scheduled 2050 project. The translucent addition is envisioned. The broader planning story also includes preserving Pulau Unum and water exchange around it.

stages.title: Outlet construction
stages.body: Build below water inside the enclosure.

stages.title: Permanent protection
stages.body: Close the corresponding dike segment; remove temporary works.

stages.title: Ground preparation
stages.body: Ground improvement and earthworks; schematic ordering.
